risks.if_unproven: priced as having a very high shutter count near its mechanical limit

risks.proof: A clear photo of the sensor with the mirror locked up, or a sample image of a white wall at f/22.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring professional sensor cleaning or having minor defects

risks.proof: A photo showing the included battery and charger.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only with no battery or charger included

proof_requests: Screenshot of the shutter count from the most recent photo.

Photos of the battery, charger, and any other included accessories.

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Nikon D810. It can be priced at the worst-case scenario for a used professional body (high shutter count and no accessories).
